selection_rule: All reviewed men’s and women’s bouts contesting at least one full WBA, WBC, IBF or WBO world title. Defenses, vacancies and unifications qualify. Interim, regular/secondary, silver, regional, youth and eliminator titles do not. Refresh reviewed facts when requested; no future date or opponent inferred.
